name: hybrid_mix
comment: Four mounts, three frameworks, two executors and a handler pool in one process. The driver's shakedown target: it produces every population except uploads and websockets (see asgi_bare.json for those) and it is the only in-tree app where a stream on one executor lane runs beside a blocking view on a pool lane.
comment_headers_ignore: transfer-encoding is a per-server FRAMING choice, not a content difference: measured 2026-09-01, uvicorn frames an app body with no declared length as chunked while m0serve buffers it and sends Content-Length. The decoded bytes are identical and the digest still compares them; framing itself is gated by smoke-wsgi-stream and smoke-asgi, not here.
comment_reload_touch: For --churn-mode reload: the file whose mtime the driver bumps (os.utime, content untouched, nothing for git to see). The reloader compares nanoseconds, so a touch is a change.
